material_findings.title: From if to Oops — deterministic isogeny fault-oracle research
material_findings.facts: Authors Banegas, Dimitrova and Trimoska submitted the paper October 29, 2026. They report full-key recovery in software fault simulation of deterministic OSIDH-LD, and upper bounds of 297 and 222 fault-oracle queries for two variants. Experimental claims are not independently reproduced.
missing_verification: Review full paper, reference code and licenses; check overlap with current cryptographic solvers.
Reproduce only in isolated locally controlled software fixtures with synthetic keys; do not test public systems or devices.
material_findings.deduplication: Distinct from the agent-security papers in PRs #230/#231; not promoted as an implemented solver.
